verdict.rationale: AvaTax calculates jurisdiction-aware tax during invoicing across 200+ countries and feeds results into ERP, ecommerce, and POS systems. Country-specific invoice formats, validations, and submission come from Avalara E-Invoicing and Live Reporting, a separate add-on product rather than AvaTax itself. Missing for 10: evidence that required VAT invoice fields and seller/buyer VAT registration numbers flow onto invoices, locale-specific invoice rules within AvaTax itself, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
